state.question: What is the full official name of this landmark, according to the supplied record?
state.answer: The full official name of this landmark is the Lettie Pate Whitehead Evans Administration Building. This is according to the supplied building record. The building is also known as Tech Tower, as indicated by the visible signage. The building's architecture appears to be Romanesque Revival in style.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://facilities.gatech.edu/sites/default/files/2023-05/histpresplan.pdf): Tech Tower is the Lettie Pate Whitehead Evans Administration Building. Completed in 1888, it was designed by Bruce and Morgan in the Romanesque Revival style. Its historical roles included teaching and administration.
